lesson.title: 3.3 Am, Is, and Are
lesson.unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
lesson.goal: Choose am, is or are for I, he, she and they with known actions, then ask and answer What are you doing? with a known action.
lesson.grammar_function: I am; he/she is; they are, affirmative. What are you doing? / I am + a known -ing action, kept distinct from the occupation question What is your job?; do/does is not generalized.
lesson.prerequisite: 3.2 I/you/we frames plus Unit 1 he/she/they, is/are, actions, baby and babies.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say is and are sentences about known people and complete the What are you doing? exchange.
